AGRICULTURE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Integrated Farming? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Integrated Farming.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Integrated Farming.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Integrated Farming.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Integrated Farming.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Leftover Food? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Leftover Food.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Leftover Food.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Leftover Food.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Leftover Food.

6. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos? (1 mark)

   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles? (1 mark)

15. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Animal Feed: Hay? (1 mark)

   B. Tertiary consumers

   B. Ice melting to water

   D. Milk souring
